title: Bound parity-sketch erasure of two stage-17 body lanes
body:
On the two exact #7113 stage-17 Type B body lanes at clocks 4646 and 4660, allow any 2×2 erased matrix depending on up to five linear Walsh parities. At width two the polarized quadratic form has rank 16 and every sketch cell retains rank at least 6. The target needs at least 7/8 of one old lane’s displacement capacity. One normalized rank-16 core supplies at most 3/4 per charged volume, requiring at least 7/6 old lane volumes. The directed tariff funds less than 1.003. The optimistic gross upper is below −20.798 raw. **NO VERIFIED GAIN.**

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12, run `python3.12 -I -B research/p104-stage17-parity-sketch-erasure-bound/replay.py`. Two exact methods check the rational bounds and one extremal five-parity control over all 65,536 addresses. The registered replay, exact commit and mode check, Git-free read-only export replay, and all 27 onboarding tests passed locally. Address-mixing erasure, larger sketches, and a different core remain open.

#7334/#7113 supply the complete comparator and literal caller, #7416 the two-lane stage-17 setting, #7406 the projector and #7397 the volume tariff. OpenAI Codex and its subagents materially assisted the proof, implementation and independent replay.
